description:
Scan Bing Webmaster Tools for queries sitting in positions 5-15 with non-trivial impressions. Bing's index backs Copilot, ChatGPT search, and Perplexity grounding, so a Bing rank gap is an LLM-citation gap.

Query-level only: Bing has no single page+query API, so - unlike gsc_quick_wins, which returns (page, query) pairs - these carry no url. Sorted by impressions desc.

Requires BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY (Bing Webmaster Tools -> Settings -> API Access). Best-effort: returns config_missing if unset.

limit.description: Maximum number of queries to return. Defaults to 50; cap is 200.

max_position.description: Maximum average Bing position to include. Defaults to 15 (bottom of page 2).

min_impressions.description: Minimum total impressions to include. Filters out long-tail noise. Default 30 (lower than GSC; Bing volume is smaller).

min_position.description: Minimum average Bing position to include. Defaults to 5 (top of page 1).

window.description: Lookback window in days, applied to Bing's weekly buckets. One of 30, 60, or 90. Default 90.

name: bing_quick_wins
title: Bing quick wins (positions 5-15)
